title: static publisher backlinks
description: The incoming links for one document, published at /backlinks/$UUID.json. It is derived from markdown-index's wikilink graph: every resolved INTERNAL edge whose target is a published document becomes one entry on that document. Unresolved targets, website links, and self-links are dropped. Every published document has a file, with an empty array when nothing links to it.

document_id.description: The UUID of the document these are backlinks for. It is also the file name.

backlinks.description: Incoming links, sorted by source title, then link title, then source UUID.

backlink.title: backlink
backlink.description: One resolved wikilink pointing at the document.

from_document_id.description: UUID of the source document. The frontend routes to /#/$from_document_id.

from_name.description: The source document's display title (front matter title, else file name).

from_relative_path.description: The source document's path relative to the vault root, with forward slashes.

title.description: The link's display text: the pipe alias when present, otherwise the raw target.

label.description: Only resolved internal links become backlinks. Website links have no document UUID to attach to.
